title: Grant indirect read on Privacy Notice tables in Privacy Notice Impl.
summary: The Privacy Notice Impl. codeunit now grants indirect read permission on Privacy Notice and Privacy Notice Approval tables to allow non-SUPER users to check privacy notice approval state in Copilot and service sessions without NavPermissionException.
key_points: Privacy Notice permission in the codeunit changed from im to rim, adding read
New read permission added for Privacy Notice Approval, needed for the Enabled/Disabled FlowFields
Lets non-SUPER users pass the capability check in service, Copilot and MCP sessions before a company is opened
Depends on a platform change that gives these system tables inherent indirect read (rX)
Keeps least privilege since only objects that declare indirect read can read the tables
